This world is more of a lie than even some of the most cynical of you realize. My life has taken a very depressing turn after things I have learned have turned my own history upside down and inside out. My Patriotism has abused, and now I know my Patriotism to have been misguided, and in a few cases - evil.

I just want to let you all know how important this place is, as long as it stands, for being a bastion of honest debate in a world gone completely of the rails.

I cannot maintain an account here anymore, because in moments of unrestrained rage I will sometimes post things that might hurt my "contingency plans" in case what I think is about to happen actually does happen.

I hope everyone finds some way, in the coming weeks, to make something positive out of this world. If you must lash out in violence., like so many of us have considered and prepared for - please make sure you are selective. Don't punish everyone on the other side, because many of them aren't gifted with your intellect, insight, or even able to get unbiased information any more.
